mapper.insert: INSERT INTO REVIEWS (meetup_id, member_id, content, rating, is_public) VALUES (#{meetupId}, #{memberId}, #{content}, #{rating}, #{isPublic})
mapper.select:
SELECT r.review_id AS reviewId, r.meetup_id AS meetupId, r.member_id AS memberId, r.content, r.rating, r.likes_count AS likesCount, r.views_count AS viewsCount, r.is_public AS isPublic, CASE WHEN r.delete_yn='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS deleteYn, TO_CHAR(r.created_at,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createdAt, TO_CHAR(r.updated_at,'YYYY-MM-DD') AS updatedAt, ri.image_id AS imageId FROM REVIEWS r LEFT JOIN REVIEW_IMAGES ri ON r.review_id = ri.review_id WHERE r.meetup_id = #{meetupId} AND r.delete_yn = 'N' AND r.is_public = 'Y'
ORDER BY r.likes_count DESC, r.review_id DESC
ORDER BY r.review_id DESC

mapper.update: UPDATE REVIEWS SET content = #{content}, rating = #{rating}, is_public = #{isPublic}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE REVIEWS SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
UPDATE REVIEWS SET is_public = #{isPublic}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE review_id = #{reviewId}
